items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I don't know, maybe Mary Lou Williams might have made the arrangement on it. I don't know who made the arrangement.

ctx.x: Yeah. But, of course, they could sort of -- they couldn't play anything. They could cook it up in their heads --

That's all, they couldn't write the music or nothing. They hummed it to me and I wrote it down, right out there. But I had my old guitar with me, too, and we sat on the riverbank at 4:00 in the morning, that's how I wrote that down. Fay Terro and Van. And I gave him that lead sheet and he tore out with it. I don't know, maybe Mary Lou Williams might have made the arrangement on it. I don't know who made the arrangement. Andy would know, I guess.
Yeah, it was -- whatever it was, it was a very simple arrangement.
